kata — keybindings

Global                                 Detail                                            Forms
?         help                         tab/C-j        next tab                           ctrl+o         save or apply
q/ctrl+c  quit                         shift+tab/C-k  prev tab                           esc            cancel
1-4       switch tab                   enter          jump to referenced issue           tab/shift+tab  change field
P         projects                     esc/backspace  back                               ctrl+e         open editor
I         inbox                        e              edit body                          ctrl+u         clear prompt
D         daemons                      c              new comment
F         federation                   R              typed reply to selected comment    Filters
C         credentials                  ]              next comment link                  /       search
T         attention                    [              previous comment link              s       cycle status filter
L         toggle layout                p              set parent                         f       filter (form)
                                       b              add blocker                        c       clear filters
Graph                                  l              add related                        ctrl+r  reset filter form
k           up                         +              add label
j           down                       -              remove label
up/C-p      scroll up                  a              assign owner
down/C-n    scroll down                A              clear owner
pgup/M-v    page up                    t              timed assignment
pgdown/C-v  page down                  !              set priority
g/C-M-<     first                      O              set repeat
G/C-M->     last
enter       open detail                Children
space       expand/collapse            N      new child
right       expand                     j/k    move child cursor
left        collapse                   ↑↓     scroll detail viewport
E           expand/collapse all        enter  open child
n           new issue (form)
v           toggle flat/nested view
o           toggle graph order
x           close
r           reopen
d           set dates
X           delete issue
M           move to another project
u           undo last issue action

press ? to return
